title: Tooling: 2.26× faster production emitted-local audit via integer rows with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production `research/complex-k492-owner-repair/code/hpe_audit_local.py` still stored each sparse scalar row as a dictionary of `Fraction` values. woklerx’s opt-in adapter `research/emitted-local-integer-replay-seed90/` (incorporated [#1184](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1184)) already proved shared-denominator integer rows with identical complete local-audit receipts. This PR wires that equivalent rewrite into the **production** k492 checker.

SELECTED-SOURCE-bound `research/complex-sw4-frame8/local/hpe_audit_local.py` copies are deliberately left pairwise so the selected inventory is not refreshed by this tip.

No certificate κ pins change. Same-tip provenance hygiene:
- `research/complex-signed-prefix-audit/` and `research/selected1094-wire-prefix-audit/` demote the k492 `hpe_audit_local.py` pin to **provenance** and retarget live `VERIFY` inputs to the still-pairwise sw4 checker.
- `research/emitted-local-integer-replay-seed90/` vendors pairwise-era bytes as local `baseline.py`.
- Non-VERIFY hygiene inventories (stage-diagonal / center-quarter / dyadic) retarget off the rewritten k492 path onto the pairwise sw4 checker.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with `taskset -c 0`, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median complete local-audit wall time **7.080 → 3.131 s (2.26×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Complete receipts match the baseline checker (`assertions=31`, `controls=25`).

Package: `research/emitted-local-integer-production/`.
Tip: `3bc76f12b29732e901f13b19d341253379f04cb1`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/emitted-local-integer-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/emitted-local-integer-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/emitted-local-integer-production
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-signed-prefix-audit --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected1094-wire-prefix-audit --check-only
python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_emitted_local_integer_production
taskset -c 0 python3.12 -I -B research/emitted-local-integer-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_EMITTED_LOCAL_INTEGER_PRODUCTION assertions=31 controls=25 corruption=subprocess_failure certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/emitted-local-integer-production outcome=completed
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
PASS_IDENTICAL_EMITTED_LOCAL_INTEGER_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy ADD-drop foil rejects via subprocess failure. Package gates under `-O` still launch assertion-enabled children. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): woklerx’s `research/emitted-local-integer-replay-seed90/` / [#1184](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1184) (opt-in integer rows; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2329) / [#2348](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2348) (same production-promotion + provenance pattern). No competing open PR on production k492 `hpe_audit_local.py` at refresh.

Credit woklerx, icekylinx, and the retained local-checker lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
